prior_year_events.impact_description: deterioration of GBP 2.1m (net) on 2013 year of account

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 260 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 1.274 million in 2014, representing a 1.49% release of its opening gross reserves. This net release was a mixed development, with favourable run-off on Motor (third party liability) business being partially offset by adverse development on Motor (other classes) and Reinsurance inwards. The 2013 year of account had previously suffered a net deterioration of GBP 2.1 million due to two large incurred claims and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims, though this was offset by improvements in 2012 and prior underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: The GBP 2.1m deterioration on the 2013 year of account mentioned in the narrative is a net figure. The prior year development for individual lines of business is derived from the 'run-off deviation' table, which is considered gross.
